news_items.title: The Baobab Donut has arrived!
news_items.excerpt: Discover our new creation with exotic and tangy notes, a true journey for the taste buds.
news_items.image_prompt: A beautiful baobab-flavored donut with white icing and baobab fruit powder, on a wooden table.
content: We are thrilled to announce the latest addition to our family of flavors: the Baobab Donut! This unique creation is a tribute to the iconic African 'tree of life'.

The baobab fruit, known for its high vitamin C content and tangy, citrus-like flavor, is the star of this new recipe. We've incorporated its powder into a light, airy dough and a delicate glaze, creating a perfect balance of sweetness and tartness.
Come and taste this little wonder in our store starting today. It's a limited edition, so don't wait too long to embark on this gustatory journey!

news_items.title: Le Botocoin at the AfroMontréal Festival
news_items.excerpt: Come meet us at our stand for three days of festivities, music, and of course, donuts.
news_items.image_prompt: A vibrant festival scene with a food stall for 'Le Botocoin', people enjoying donuts.
content: Le Botocoin is proud to be a partner of the AfroMontréal Festival this year! Join us from August 22nd to 24th at Parc Jean-Drapeau for an unforgettable celebration of African and Caribbean cultures.

Our stand will be offering our greatest classics, as well as some exclusive surprises specially created for the event. It's the perfect opportunity to share a gourmet moment with family or friends in a festive and colorful atmosphere.
We look forward to seeing many of you there to dance, sing, and feast with us!

news_items.title: The Secret of our Ginger Juice
news_items.excerpt: We reveal some secrets behind our famous homemade ginger juice, a family recipe.
news_items.image_prompt: Close-up on a glass of iced ginger juice with a slice of lemon and mint leaves.
content: You often ask us for the secret to our ginger juice, so invigorating and flavorful. While we can't reveal everything (a family recipe is a family recipe!), we can share some of our principles.

It all starts with the selection of fresh, high-quality ginger, which we press ourselves to extract all its potency. We then add a hint of pineapple for sweetness and a touch of lemon for freshness. No artificial flavors, no preservatives, just the pure taste of good ingredients.
This drink, passed down from generation to generation, is more than just a beverage for us; it's a concentrate of energy and well-being, perfect to accompany our donuts.

about_franchise_faq_items.q: What is the typical timeline to open?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: From signing to grand opening, the process typically takes 3 to 6 months, depending on site selection and construction.
While helpful, it's not mandatory. We provide comprehensive training. A passion for quality and customer service is most important.

about_franchise_faq_items.q: Can I convert an existing location?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: Yes, we are open to conversions if the location meets our criteria and can be adapted to our brand standards.

about_franchise_faq_items.q: Do I get a protected territory?
about_franchise_faq_items.a: Yes, each franchisee receives a protected territory defined by demographic data and population density.

faq.q: How much setup time is needed?
faq.a: Minimal! Our donuts arrive in easy-to-display boxes. You can have a beautiful spread ready in 10-15 minutes.

faq.a: Yes, they hold up well. We recommend keeping them in a shaded, cool area, especially on warm days.
